scope: New read-only source audit. No PT/model load, actor forward, GPU/physics, SSH, budget write or training.

primary_sources.summary: SuperMimic alternates collection, autoregressive dynamics fitting and policy gradients through a frozen learned model. Context contains episode-fixed physical parameters. Reference goals include future frames. Reset sampling revisits low-return motion regions. A critic bootstraps short imagined returns.
primary_sources.source_word_budget_note: Short paraphrase only; no full paper copied.

primary_sources.classification: Independent downstream reproduction as README explicitly states; not original authors' official code

confirmed_adapter_differences.actual: H1Bridge.current packs contact_history12 + applied_torque30 + public_request1. _wm_rollout uses logged context at each training step; policy_update fixes sampled start context across imagined steps.
confirmed_adapter_differences.upstream: Episode-fixed friction/calibration/COM; holding this xi fixed is consistent there.
confirmed_adapter_differences.consequence: Changing variables are supplied as future ground truth during dynamics fit but are stale during imagination. This is a semantic model-input mismatch.
confirmed_adapter_differences.limit: Not proven sole cause of failed physical jumps; nonzero mathematical Jacobians already established.

confirmed_adapter_differences.actual: invariant_features drops root XY; H1GoalMdp.obs appends dynamic xi, but no step-relative displacement. Analytic goal exposes absolute reference X.
confirmed_adapter_differences.consequence: States at different step distances can share actor and dynamics inputs, despite different terrain contact outcomes.
confirmed_adapter_differences.limit: Prior source counterexample remains valid; no new physical causal test.

confirmed_adapter_differences.actual: PhysicalActionQueue has per-episode legs/wheels delay0,2500,5000us, prior applied processed targets, pending state and physics ticks. Old WM sees ingress clipped6 action and physical state, not queue state/DR delay.
confirmed_adapter_differences.consequence: Ingress action is legitimate only with enough actuator state/context. Calling it executed6 does not mean a single target was active during all four physical ticks.
confirmed_adapter_differences.limit: Control period10000us is not fixed10000us latency.

confirmed_adapter_differences.actual: Current own root task and partial foreign pose reference, including masked XY/spins and post-apex Z/Vz; not full reference motion tracking.
confirmed_adapter_differences.limit: Robot constraints require explicit retargeting; preserving paper learning loop does not make raw foreign actions valid.
Config differences alone do not prove a root cause or justify unsafe wholesale default changes; buffer/reset/phase and4090 memory must be designed jointly. Existing FP32 and physical guards stay.
